Great exhaust fan and extremely easy to install.  It took my husband and I a bit of time to install the screws in the correct place to hold the exhaust fan to the wall, but after that it only took us minutes to hang it up. We bought this fan to replace the cheap microwave range. It really sucked the exhaust fumes very well.  The only issue is that because it is so powerful, the sound vibrates across the hollow walls of my house so it is louder than my old range. But it certainly did its job!
Only displays military time. Owners manual states some units come this way and can't be changed. Kind of annoying. Fan is powerful and quiet.

The thickness of the metal frame makes it hard to close the filter holder. So it can't be easily used with newer recipes that invert the Aerooress to steep before applying the filter and collar, turning the unit over and pressing out the coffee. The thickness of the filter requires too much pressure on the assembly to be safe. For the original Aeropress recipe, the metal filter works about as well as paper filters and allows varying amounts of fines through to the cup.
Just bought a new Keurig and it is nice to be able to use  whatever brand of coffee we want and this product allows us to.

Exactly what I needed. It arrived quickly, nicely packaged and in good condition. I used it for loose leaf tea and did not have any issue with the leaves leaking out into my cup. The balls are smaller, so it doesn't hold that much, but it's perfect for me.
